meta.text: Start with 7. Multiply by 3, subtract 4, multiply by 2, add 5, subtract 9, multiply by 2, add 7, subtract 3, multiply by 3, subtract 11. What is the result? 39, then 64, then 181. The answer is 181.
meta.note: columns[l][c] = dims 0-63 of the residual stream after block l+1 at token column_tokens[c], divided by that layer's 99th-percentile |value| and clipped to [-1, 1], times 127.
